text:
Ivy: Heads-up 1 - support: customers save a per-route view after selecting a model in the inspector, then later the console shows cost using the route default. Confusing.
Sam: Right now POST /saved_views persists route+filters only. No model info stored.
Omar: Quick UX patch: show a small "created with: <model>" hint derived from local state so users see why numbers differed.
Pri: Long-term we should add an optional binding to saved_views: {model_id, sample_rate, binding_mode}. binding_mode=exact|semantic. Also define fallback: route_default|nearest|reject.
Sam: Need admin toggle per-org to disable model pinning, and capture pinned_estimate at save time for support.
Ivy: Proposal: sprint 1 = UI hint + migrate CTA; sprint 2 = API v2 + migration job; sprint 3 = admin controls + telemetry events for binding resolution.
CI-Bot: branch feature/saveview-bindings pushed. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/1042
